title: Bicycle derailleur gears
prompt: the rear half of a bicycle on a stand: pedal, shift up and down, the derailleur moves the chain across the cassette and the wheel speeds change; see-through shows the shifter cable, derailleur parallelogram, jockey wheels, cassette, freehub and chain
blurb: Pedal and shift an eight-speed bicycle to follow the chain, derailleur and freehub as the rear wheel changes speed.
